summary: Represents an interior door within a Clustercraft (likely a rocket or spaceship module in Oxygen Not Included).  This class manages the button that allows switching between interior and exterior views of the module within the game's side screen UI. It interacts with the `ClusterManager` to change the active world view.

keyMethods.name: OnPrefabInit
keyMethods.description: Registers this door with the `Components.ClusterCraftInteriorDoors` list during prefab initialization.

keyMethods.name: OnCleanUp
keyMethods.description: Removes this door from the `Components.ClusterCraftInteriorDoors` list during cleanup.

keyMethods.name: SidescreenEnabled
keyMethods.description: Always returns `true`, indicating the side screen button is always enabled.

keyMethods.name: SidescreenButtonInteractable
keyMethods.description: Checks if the side screen button should be interactable. It's interactable only if the current world has a parent world (is a sub-world, likely representing the interior of a module) and the parent world ID differs from the current world ID. This prevents interaction when viewing the main world or if no parent world exists.

keyMethods.name: OnSidescreenButtonPressed
keyMethods.description: Handles the button press event. It switches the active world view in the `ClusterManager` to the parent world of the current world.

keyMethods.name: ButtonSideScreenSortOrder
keyMethods.description: Defines the sorting order of this button within the side screen UI.  Returns 20.

keyMethods.name: SetButtonTextOverride
keyMethods.description: Currently throws a `NotImplementedException`.  Likely intended for overriding the button text, but not implemented in this class.

keyMethods.name: HorizontalGroupID
keyMethods.description: Returns -1, indicating that this button doesn't belong to a specific horizontal group in the UI.

keyProperties.name: SidescreenButtonText
keyProperties.description: Gets the text displayed on the side screen button.  Uses a string from `UI.UISIDESCREENS.ROCKETMODULESIDESCREEN.BUTTONVIEWEXTERIOR.LABEL`.

keyProperties.name: SidescreenButtonTooltip
keyProperties.description: Gets the tooltip text for the side screen button. Uses different strings based on whether the button is interactable.
